content:
We've been using iOS 27 for about two months now. Of course, it's a beta—still 4 to 6 weeks away from its official launch. But even though I've been running the beta on my phone for the last two months, I can't say I've really noticed it. It just... works.

I do, of course, still get the urge to open up Software Update every couple of weeks to install the latest beta. That's the one constant of the iOS 27 beta experience.

Beyond that, I can't think of any of the usual complaints people typically associate with beta software. There's basically no battery drain, no overheating, no weird stuttering, no random crashes.

Running iOS 27 gets you all the benefits of the new OS—Siri AI, AirPods EQ, new wallet passes in Safari, beefier photo AI editing features, and more—without any of the typical downsides of running cutting-edge beta software. Honestly, that's quite an achievement.

iOS 26 itself wasn't exactly stable from the start, which is perhaps part of the reason. iOS 26.5 in particular, for some reason (at least for me), caused my phone to start respringing (software crash with a black screen and loading indicator) constantly.

This is all anecdotal, of course, but you can ask just about anyone and you'll hear some iOS 26 horror story or another.

iOS 27 is killing it

With that said, iOS 27 delivers across the board on speed improvements, bug fixes, stability, and quality-of-life enhancements. You might not notice at first, because Siri AI is doing a ton of indexing in the background—though Apple recently pushed out iOS 26.6, which starts the Siri AI background indexing process, so when you upgrade to iOS 27 you won't have to wait. Once you're past that, it's smooth sailing.

I can't wait for users at large to get their hands on iOS 27 when it officially launches next month. It's hard to believe, but it really does feel like Apple has fixed all the major annoyances of iOS. Of course, it's not perfect—software never is—but this is hands down the best iPhone experience I can remember.

iOS 27 will support all the same iPhone models that supported iOS 26, meaning the iPhone 11 and newer will all get the update.

My favorite Apple accessories:

  • Anker MagSafe/Qi2 ultra-slim external battery
  • AirPods Pro 3 (2x the active noise cancellation of AirPods Pro 2!)
  • Anker Nano 45W fast charger with smart display
  • Anker Nano 13-in-1 MacBook dock
  • Logitech MX Master 4 Mac mouse
  • Belkin Qi2 3-in-1 MagSafe charging stand
